title: HubSpot Funnel Tracer
why: HubSpot pulls in a huge volume of inbound leads through content, free tools and ads, so turning those leads into paying customers is its core growth problem. This tool follows every lead to revenue and shows where value leaks.
problem: Management observes high lead generation but relatively low revenue growth. Build an AI analytics system that traces the customer journey from campaign exposure through lead generation, conversion and revenue, identifying where the marketing funnel is losing value.
data_note: 6,000 leads from one quarter with every marketing touch, sales stage and closed revenue (sample data).

steps.detail: Ad exposure, visits, downloads, demos, sales calls, deals
Order every touch per lead into a path
Removal effect of each channel on the chance to convert
Show what the default report gets wrong
Logistic regression on lead traits and follow-up speed
Biggest stage drop and channels with leads but no revenue

questions: Where is the funnel losing the most value?
Which channel brings leads but no revenue?
Why does last-touch reporting mislead us?
What would faster follow-up be worth?
author: K Bhargav Raju
